morphology.pattern_note: 沿用输入的整词归档方式；可核实的姓氏用法写作 Siddhu，不作马来语词缀拆分。不能仅凭 ddh 推定标准马来语读音。

senses.zh_definition: 专名的一种可核实用法：Siddhu，见于南亚人名的姓氏；输入词项的具体所指及其是否具有马来语普通词义尚未确定。
senses.en_definition: An attested surname occurring in South Asian personal names; the packet's intended referent and any Malay common-word meaning remain unconfirmed.
senses.ms_definition: Siddhu ialah nama keluarga yang terdapat dalam nama individu Asia Selatan; rujukan dalam paket dan sebarang makna sebagai kata umum bahasa Melayu belum dapat dipastikan.
senses.nuances: noun 在此表示专有名词。输入没有 DBP 释义，故不能标为已核实的官方马来语词条；本项马来语释义为编写说明。以下为姓氏使用示例，并非已验证的高频搭配，也不指称特定真实人物。姓氏拼写可见 [印度人口普查历史名称表](https://censusindia.gov.in/nada/index.php/catalog/30639/download/33820/24093_1951_GOL.pdf)；当代姓名实例可见 [The University of Faisalabad](https://tuf.edu.pk/n/departments/faculty-cv/m-kashif-siddhu)。

etymology.historical_story: Siddhu is documented as a name in historical Indian records and in contemporary institutional profiles. Those attestations establish that the spelling can identify people; they do not supply a universal literal meaning or prove the origin of every family's name. Without the packet's original context, connecting this token to a particular Sanskrit root or naming tradition would be speculative. See the [historical census glossary](https://censusindia.gov.in/nada/index.php/catalog/30639/download/33820/24093_1951_GOL.pdf).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Siddhu 放进“Encik Siddhu”这张姓名牌来记：先认作姓氏，保留双 d；读音向本人核实。
